provenance.how_to_verify: Open Bluebook R21.9 and T3 (European Union treaties) and the consolidated TFEU/TEU on EUR-Lex.

positive.text: Under Article 101 TFEU, agreements that restrict competition are void.
Article 8 of the Charter protects personal data.

note: Both orders are one form (EU practice puts the treaty after the article, Bluebook before it), so the article and treaty groups appear twice; no shared authority key.
